raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fix FULL adaptive-verification cost profiling so timed replays use the configured KV context. TRITON_ATTN's capture metadata currently resets GPU `seq_lens` to 1, replacing the context prepared for the probe.

## Claims

- Preserve `VLLM_ADAPTIVE_VERIFICATION_PROFILE_CONTEXT_LEN` in the attention metadata used for timed FULL replays.
- Add a real-weight LLM startup regression for GPU/CPU KV-length consistency and document the profiling behavior.

## Validation

Tested on one RTX 2070 Max-Q (SM75), WSL2, Torch 2.14.0+cu130, Qwen3-1.7B target / Qwen3-0.6B draft, FP16, TRITON_ATTN, K=4 and profiling context 512.

| Check | Base `7651825993` | This change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FULL samples with incorrect GPU KV lengths | 35 / 35 | 0 / 35 |
| Same real LLM startup regression | Fails at GPU/CPU KV-length assertion | Pass |
| Four fixed extraction requests | Correct, 179 tokens each | Correct, all output tokens identical to base |
| Speculative acceptance; preemptions / corrupted requests | Nonzero; 0 / 0 | Nonzero; 0 / 0 |
| Related worker, Graph and speculative-decoding tests | — | 203 passed |
| Full model run with strict sync and WSL2 pinned memory | Pass | Pass |
| Applicable pre-commit hooks | — | 17 passed; commit sign-off hook also passed |

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py::test_adaptive_startup_preserves_profile_context -q
```

For a one-query probe with 512 context tokens, the base records GPU `seq_lens=[1]` and CPU `[513]`; the fix records `[513]` on both. All 35 FULL samples replay against their captured buffers, with matching Graph descriptors between versions.

<details>
<summary>Before/after commands and validation scope</summary>

From the patched checkout, create a baseline worktree and copy in the regression file:

```bash
git worktree add --detach /tmp/full-profile-base 7651825993d001759107c66cdf6983535900c874
cp tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py \
  /tmp/full-profile-base/tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py
```

Install editable vLLM and test dependencies in each worktree following `AGENTS.md`. Set `BASE_PYTHON` and `PATCHED_PYTHON` to the uv environment interpreters and download both models, then run:

```bash
(cd /tmp/full-profile-base && PYTHONPATH="$PWD" "$BASE_PYTHON" -m pytest \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py::test_adaptive_startup_preserves_profile_context -q)
PYTHONPATH="$PWD" "$PATCHED_PYTHON" -m pytest \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch_v2.py \
  tests/v1/cudagraph/test_cudagraph_manager.py \
  tests/v1/spec_decode/test_adaptive_verification.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py \
  tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py -q
```

Recorded base output:

```text
assert actual.cpu().tolist() == expected_seq_lens
AssertionError
1 failed, 1 warning in 713.09s (0:11:53)
```

Recorded seven-file regression output:

```text
203 passed, 2 warnings in 412.04s (0:06:52)
```

The submitter reviewed the three-file patch and personally reran the suite and strict model comparison on `b555f8a858`. Publication commit `7e7ab5371e`, rebased onto main `be03d19750`, retains identical patch files. Its seven-file regression output is shown above; the model baseline is `7651825993`.

Both versions use the identical regression file and an isolated Torch/CUDA overlay with stable-ABI native artifacts. All 17 applicable hooks use the repository configuration; skipped entries have no matching changed files. H200 and AMD worker CI select the test file; upstream CI results are pending.

Strict model runs use `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` and `VLLM_WSL2_ENABLE_PIN_MEMORY=1`; both versions complete profiling and all four requests. The earlier run with WSL2 pinned memory disabled fails at the existing non-pinned `NonUvaBuffer.uva` copy. Runtime validation covers single-GPU TRITON_ATTN; observer timings serve as profiling-input diagnostics.

</details>

## Details

The capture builder writes placeholder KV lengths into shared GPU buffers. Reusing it during cost profiling makes the replay read those placeholders rather than the probe's configured context.

The internal `profile_step_cost` flag selects normal execution metadata in the existing step-timing loop. It defaults to false and applies the same condition to ordinary and microbatched preparation. FULL capture and ordinary FULL warmup retain capture metadata. Probe generation, cost formulas and Graph allocation retain their existing behavior.

Related work covers MRV1 metadata ([#54604](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/54604)), DCP capture context ([#61496](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/61496)), PIECEWISE padding ([#60049](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60049)) and cost-model changes ([#62960](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62960)). This patch fixes FULL cost-probe metadata in main's existing profiling protocol and applies independently of those changes.

AI assistance was used to implement the patch, run validation, and draft this description. The submitter reviewed every changed line and personally reran the related tests and strict model comparison.

@@ -59,7 +59,7 @@ Set `enable_adaptive_verification: false` to verify the full block for every req
 
 ## Tuning the cost profile
 
-Step costs are profiled against a synthetic KV context, 8192 tokens by default. +Step costs are profiled against a synthetic KV context, 8192 tokens by default. FULL graph profiling replays retain this context when preparing attention metadata. Deployments serving much longer contexts may want to raise it so the profiled step reads a more realistic amount of cache (this matters a bit less for sparse attention models like DeepSeek-v4 since the cheap indexer is the main cost that scales with context length).
 
 ```bash
 export VLLM_ADAPTIVE_VERIFICATION_PROFILE_CONTEXT_LEN=131072

@@ -12,7 +12,9 @@
 
 import contextlib
 import gc
-from types import SimpleNamespace
+import os
+import sys
+from types import FrameType, SimpleNamespace
 from typing import Any
 
 import pytest
@@ -21,6 +23,7 @@
 from tests.utils import create_new_process_for_each_test
 from vllm.compilation.counter import compilation_counter
 from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu import cudagraph_utils as cgu
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu import model_runner as mrv2
 from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.eplb_utils import EPLBController
@@ -474,3 +477,77 @@ def test_teardown_profiling_state_clears_mamba_align_metadata(monkeypatch):
     assert runner.model_state._mamba_ctx is None
     assert runner.model_state._mamba_group_ids == []
     assert runner.model_state._mamba_spec is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda_alike(), reason="Requires GPU graph profiling"
+)
+@create_new_process_for_each_test("spawn")
+def test_adaptive_startup_preserves_profile_context():
+    """FULL cost probes must retain the configured KV context after attention prep."""
+    from vllm import LLM
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.async_utils import StepTimingCollector, StepTimingSample
+    from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.adaptive_verification import (
+        AdaptiveVerificationManager,
+    )
+
+    os.environ["VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER"] = "1"
+    os.environ["VLLM_ENABLE_V1_MULTIPROCESSING"] = "0"
+    os.environ["VLLM_ADAPTIVE_VERIFICATION_PROFILE_CONTEXT_LEN"] = "512"
+    profiles: list[list[StepTimingSample]] = []
+    seq_lengths: list[tuple[torch.Tensor, list[int]]] = []
+    fit_code = AdaptiveVerificationManager.set_initial_cost_curves.__code__
+    record_code = StepTimingCollector.record_batch.__code__
+
+    def observe_profile(frame: FrameType, event: str, arg: object) -> None:
+        if event == "call" and frame.f_code is fit_code:
+            profiles.append(list(frame.f_locals["samples"]))
+        elif (
+            event == "call"
+            and frame.f_code is record_code
+            and frame.f_locals["self"]._collecting
+            and frame.f_locals["full_cudagraph"]
+        ):
+            batch = frame.f_locals["input_batch"]
+            seq_lengths.append(
+                (batch.seq_lens.clone(), batch.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound.tolist())
+            )
+
+    previous_profiler = sys.getprofile()
+    llm = None
+    try:
+        # Observe actual startup samples; all methods and objects remain real.
+        sys.setprofile(observe_profile)
+        llm = LLM(
+            model="Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B",
+            dtype="float16",
+            max_model_len=2048,
+            max_num_seqs=4,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=64,
+            kv_cache_memory_bytes=512 << 20,
+            gpu_memory_utilization=0.8,
+            enable_prefix_caching=False,
+            distributed_executor_backend="uni",
+            attention_config={"backend": "TRITON_ATTN"},
+            compilation_config={
+                "mode": 0,
+                "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY",
+                "cudagraph_capture_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20],
+            },
+            speculative_config={
+                "method": "draft_model",
+                "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B",
+                "attention_backend": "TRITON_ATTN",
+                "num_speculative_tokens": 4,
+                "enable_adaptive_verification": True,
+            },
+        )
+        assert profiles
+        assert any(sample.full_cudagraph for sample in profiles[-1])
+        assert seq_lengths
+        for actual, expected_seq_lens in seq_lengths:
+            assert actual.cpu().tolist() == expected_seq_lens
+    finally:
+        sys.setprofile(previous_profiler)
+        if llm is not None:
+            llm.llm_engine.engine_core.shutdown()

@@ -864,6 +864,7 @@ def _dummy_run(
         is_profile: bool = False,
         valid_dummy_state_slots: bool = False,
         randomize_inputs: bool = False,
+        profile_step_cost: bool = False,
         **kwargs,
     ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor | None]:

@@ -938,6 +939,7 @@ def _dummy_run(

                 intermediate_tensors=intermediate_tensors,

+                profile_step_cost=profile_step_cost,

                 is_profile=is_profile,
                 context_len=context_len,
@@ -1166,7 +1168,7 @@ def capture_model(self, *, profile_only: bool = False) -> int:
                             for batch in self.adaptive_verification.batches_to_profile(
                                 self.cudagraph_manager.captured_token_counts()
                             ):
-                                self._dummy_run(**batch)
+                                self._dummy_run(**batch, profile_step_cost=True)
                         self.adaptive_verification.set_initial_cost_curves(timings)
                         # Release the profiling runs' activations, or the
                         # allocator cache is counted as graph memory below.
@@ -1792,6 +1794,7 @@ def execute_model(
         context_len: int = 0,
         valid_dummy_state_slots: bool = False,
         randomize_inputs: bool = False,
+        profile_step_cost: bool = False,
     ) -> ModelRunnerOutput | IntermediateTensors | None:
         if not dummy_run:
             self.draft_tokens_handler.begin_step(scheduler_output)
@@ -1961,6 +1964,11 @@ def execute_model(
         attn_metadata = None
         slot_mappings_by_layer = None
         ubatch_state: UBatchState | None = None
+        for_dummy_capture = (
+            dummy_run
+            and batch_desc.cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            and not profile_step_cost
+        )
         if batch_desc.num_ubatches > 1:
             assert self.ubatch_runner is not None
             assert block_tables is not None and slot_mappings is not None
@@ -1970,7 +1978,7 @@ def execute_model(
                 slot_mappings,
                 batch_desc,
                 dp_sync_state,
-                for_capture=dummy_run and batch_desc.cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL,
+                for_capture=for_dummy_capture,
             )
         elif not (dummy_run and skip_attn_for_dummy_run):
             assert slot_mappings is not None
@@ -1998,7 +2006,7 @@ def execute_model(
                 # FULL replay reads capture-time metadata buffers. Re-stage them
